data.exact_reserve_text: During 2019 the Syndicate released $38.3m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2018: $47.0m), arising predominantly from the Marine, Energy and Property divisions (2018: primarily from the Treaty, Energy and Marine Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2019.

data.standardized_narrative: In 2019, Syndicate 1084 reported a release of $38.3 million in technical reserves related to prior periods, representing a 1.53% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was primarily driven by favourable claims experience in the Marine, Energy, and Property divisions, with the 2018 prior year movement also stemming from the Treaty, Energy, and Marine Divisions. The syndicate also experienced significant catastrophe losses in 2019 from typhoons Hagibis and Faxai, US windstorm Dorian, and the Chile Riots, while continuing to manage ultimate claims from 2018 events including hurricanes Michael and Florence, typhoons Jebi and Trami, the Woolsey and Camp wildfires, and the Ituango hydroelectric dam.
